lines.jp:
さて。
　この青年、名を朔屋直正という。旧幕時代の幕臣めいた大層なお名前とは裏腹の、だらけたその人となりは一端とはいえ前段から窺えよう。
lines.en:
Now, then.
 This young man's name was Naomasa Sakuya. It was an imposing name fit for a retainer of the old shogunate, but the preceding episode had already offered at least a glimpse of the thoroughly dissolute character behind it.

lines.jp: つまり基本的に怠惰でいい加減で女にだらしなく、これといった特技も持たず足が速いとか膂力に秀でるとかの体の強みもなく、さりとておつむの方もまずまず日々の暮らしに差し障りがないという程度、要するになんの取り柄もない凡骨、というにもいささか足らない、これらの身上に加えて躁鬱の気があったりするので、鬱期に転がりこんだ時なぞは完全に人並み以下に成り下がる。
lines.en: He was fundamentally lazy, irresponsible, and hopeless with women. He possessed no talent worth mentioning, no physical gifts such as speed or strength, and a mind just capable enough not to interfere with daily life. In short, calling him a thoroughly ordinary mediocrity would have been faint praise. Add a tendency toward manic and depressive moods, and whenever he tumbled into one of his low periods, he sank decisively below the common run of humanity.

lines.jp:
こういう無能力者がこの年まで長じてこられたのは、実家がそこそこの旧家であったかららしい。とはいえ跡取りでもない次男坊、兄の方は申し分のない優秀人で、家督の憂いはなく、朔屋は大して期待もされず一族からは空気の如き扱いを受けてきた。
　空しい境遇と言えば言えるが、同様の立場に生まれついた者など世にはいくらでも転がっており、中には発憤して独力で身を立てる者だって珍しくはない。要は本人の志次第なのだが、この朔屋に関しては、そういった向上心とか気概というのが一切欠けていた。
lines.en:
Apparently, the only reason someone so inept had made it this far was that he came from a family of some standing. Even so, he was merely the second son, not the heir. His elder brother was irreproachably capable, leaving the succession secure, while Naomasa inspired few expectations and was treated by the clan as though he were air.
 One might call that an empty existence, but the world was full of people born to similar positions, and plenty of them found the resolve to make their own way. It all came down to personal ambition. Naomasa possessed none whatsoever.

lines.jp: それまでも穀潰しの兆しは見えていたのだが、一五の年に、ついうっかりと女の味を覚えてしまったのが決定的な契機となる。
lines.en: The signs that he would become a useless dependent were already visible, but the decisive moment came at fifteen, when he carelessly discovered the pleasures of women.

lines.jp:
勉学も運動も人並みの以下のくせ、性的好奇心だけは旺盛で日々悶々と、せっかくの思春期の気力を家族に隠れて自涜に費やすばかりであった朔屋だからして、一度女の肌に味を占めてしまえばもういけない。
　当時の彼の相手というのは、実家に通いの年上の手伝い娘で、ひょんな経緯から朔屋の自慰の現場に遭遇してしまい、主家の坊ちゃまの秘密踏んでしまった気まずさと（もっともこの頃の朔屋は隙さえあらば逸物いじりに溺れていたから、いずれ誰かに知られる事は必然だったのだが）、日頃良く懐いてきていた彼への情にほだされて（実のところこれとて春機に目覚めた朔屋が、じゃれる振りして彼女の尻に抱きついていた、というのが真相なのだが）、ついつい閨の秘め事を手解きしてしまったのであった。
lines.en:
Though below average in both study and athletics, Naomasa possessed sexual curiosity in abundance. Day after frustrated day, he spent the precious energy of adolescence masturbating in secret. Once he acquired a taste for a woman's skin, there was no saving him.
 His partner at the time was an older maid who came to work at the family home. By some chance, she caught Naomasa masturbating. Embarrassment at having stumbled onto the young master's secret--though Naomasa then fondled himself at every opening, so discovery had only been a matter of time--combined with affection for the boy who was always clinging to her--though the truth was that the newly awakened Naomasa pretended to play while wrapping himself around her backside. In a moment of weakness, she initiated him into the secrets of the bedchamber.

lines.jp: これ自体はまあ良くも悪くのありがちの、まあ少年にとってはやや幸運な、少し淫らで少し甘酸っぱい情戯の通過儀礼に過ぎなかったろう。家族も気づいて黙認した節がある。
lines.en: For better or worse, the encounter itself was nothing more than a common rite of passage: somewhat fortunate for the boy, a little indecent, and a little bittersweet. His family appeared to notice and quietly tolerate it.

lines.jp: ただ朔屋少年は、その一度きりで終わらせるつもりなど毛頭無く、それまでは隙あらば自涜可能な機会を独りで窺っていたところ、以降は手伝い娘と二人で秘め事に耽られる隙を狙う鵜の目鷹の目に変わっただけの、なんとも始末に負えない。
lines.en: Young Naomasa, however, had not the slightest intention of letting it end after one occasion. Before, he had watched like a hawk for chances to masturbate alone. Afterward, he simply watched like a hawk for chances to enjoy secret pleasures with the maid. He was utterly beyond handling.

lines.jp: 実家では皆寝静まった夜更け以外はどうにも人目が厳しいと覚った朔屋少年は、それならと手伝い娘の下宿に押しかけるようになり、しまいには入り浸りとなった。手伝い娘の方も、年下を甘えさせる事が嬉しい性情の女で、初めは諫めながらもどうしても流されてしまう、これは確かに、娘の優しさというよりだらしなさだが、一度体を許してしまった相手にはどうにも甘い女の性ばかりを責められまい。
lines.en: Naomasa realized that the family home offered no privacy except in the dead of night, after everyone had gone to bed. He began inviting himself to the maid's lodgings and eventually spent nearly all his time there. She, for her part, enjoyed indulging those younger than herself. She admonished him at first but inevitably gave in. Admittedly, that spoke more to her own lack of restraint than her kindness, but one could hardly condemn only the weakness of a woman who had already given herself to someone and could no longer deny him.

lines.jp: 言うまでもなく問題は朔屋であり、見る間に学業は下落し、家を長く空けるようになり、それまでは勤勉であった手伝い娘が仕事に穴を空けがちになったとあっては、流石に実家の勘気を蒙った。
lines.en: Needless to say, Naomasa was the problem. His studies declined before their eyes, he spent long stretches away from home, and the previously diligent maid began missing work. At last, the family brought its wrath down upon them.

lines.jp:
結局娘には充分の手当を持たせて里に帰し、朔屋は家長の鉄拳制裁の後で寄宿制の学校に封じこまれる事になったのが顛末の、厳しい学校だったからと、親も一安心したのは迂闊であった。
　こういう場合、親の目から離れてしまうのは逆効果なのである。どんなところにでもいる放蕩児が、朔屋の小遣い目当てに寮からの抜け道を教授した事から始まって、酒の呑み方、商売女を買うあれこれを仕込みくさった事に両親が気づいたのは、学校からの落第の通知と寄宿舎に相当期間戻っていない事の報せに激怒し、あれこれ手を尽くした挙げ句、すっかりおけらになって曖昧宿の娼妓の部屋でにっちもさっちもいかなくなっていた次男坊を発見した時の、後の祭の馬鹿見本である。
lines.en:
In the end, the maid was given a generous settlement and sent back to her village. After receiving the head of the family's discipline by fist, Naomasa was confined to a boarding school. His parents reassured themselves that it was a strict institution. That was careless.
 In cases like his, removing the parents' eyes only made matters worse. A wastrel of the sort found everywhere, attracted by Naomasa's allowance, taught him a route out of the dormitory. From there came lessons in drinking and every filthy particular of buying a prostitute's company. His parents learned of it only after the school reported that he had failed and had not returned to the dormitory for a considerable time. Furious, they exhausted every means of searching and finally found their penniless second son stranded in a prostitute's room at a dubious lodging house. By then, the farce was complete and it was much too late.

lines.jp:
ここまで落ちれば後は外面をどう取り繕おうと矯正が利くものではない───
　勉学も成らず、社会の中で身を立てる道も持たず、かといって実家で飼い殺しにしようともたびたび金を持ち出しては女と酒に空費する。
lines.en:
Once he had fallen this far, no amount of outward respectability could reform him--
he could not succeed in his studies or make a place for himself in society, yet when the family tried to keep him idle at home, he repeatedly stole money and squandered it on women and drink.

lines.jp: ここまで堕落しながらも、朔屋の性情は不思議と荒まず、浮ついた坊ちゃん気性のままで長じたのはせめても救いか───いや、どう考えても帳尻合わず、慰めにもならない。
lines.en: Even after such degeneration, Naomasa somehow did not become bitter or vicious. He grew up with the same flighty temperament of a spoiled young master. Was that at least some small mercy? No. By any accounting, it balanced nothing and offered no consolation at all.

lines.jp: しまいには激昂した海軍士官出の伯父御が、船上暮らしの厳しさで性根矯め直すと船員学校に叩きこんだところで、時既に遅し、実家からの仕送りが打ち切られても稼ぐ事知らず、たかれる相手にはたかり、時には情夫まがいに女の部屋に流連し、いっそ見事なまでにだらけきった毎日が朔屋の日常となった。
lines.en: At last, an enraged uncle who had served as a naval officer threw him into a maritime academy, hoping the rigors of life at sea would straighten him out. It was already too late. Even when the family cut off his allowance, Naomasa had no idea how to earn his keep. He sponged off anyone he could and sometimes lingered in women's rooms as something not far removed from a kept man. Days of almost admirably complete indolence became his ordinary life.

lines.jp: だからあの夜だって、乏しくなった懐中を、ならいっそ一晩でぱっと遣ってしまおうと港町まで繰り出しただけの事、稼ぎ口を探すどころか誰ぞに頭を下げて無心しようとも考えずに、刹那的な快楽を溺れる朔屋青年、一夜明けて財布を逆さに振っても埃しか出なくなった時には、少しばかりは悔やむ事だろう。反省はしないだろうが。
lines.en: And so, on that particular night, his pocket had grown light and he had simply gone into the harbor town, deciding he might as well spend the rest in one glorious evening. It never occurred to him to seek work, or even bow his head and ask someone for a loan. Naomasa drowned himself in pleasure from one moment to the next. When morning came and an upended purse yielded nothing but dust, he might regret it a little. Repent? Never.

lines.jp:
それに、次の朝などは考えてもしかたのない遠い未来の事なのだ。
　今は金髪の、目覚ましいような美女二人を両脇に侍らせてやに下がっているとあっては、先の事などこの邦の政局を占うより、難しい。
lines.en:
Besides, the next morning belonged to the distant future, and there was no point thinking about anything so remote.
 At present, he sat grinning with a dazzling blond beauty on either side. Predicting what came next was harder than predicting the politics of the nation.

lines.jp:
場末の酒場のひ弱い灯りに、タンブラーを干す手の筋が陰翳濃く浮き上がる、返す刀で安酒の瓶注ぐ手もぶれて、タンブラーの中は大波小波、頭上の灯りも酒の水面に揺れている。揺れているのは朔屋のおつむの乏しい中味も然りであり、既に酔眼朦朧と熟柿の息を鯨の潮めかして噴き上げれば、灯りはあの珍かな幻日環のように二重にぶれていた。
　こう灯りが二重写しになるのは深酔いした時には良くある事だから良いとして、朔屋は目線を下ろす先、まずは左に、
lines.en:
In the feeble light of a disreputable tavern, heavy shadows picked out the tendons of his hand as he drained a tumbler. The hand that followed through to pour more cheap liquor wavered, sending great and little waves across the glass and making the light overhead tremble on its surface. The meager contents of Naomasa's skull were swaying just as badly. His eyes were already clouded with drink, and his overripe-persimmon breath spouted like a whale. The light doubled before him like a rare parhelic circle.
 Seeing a light double was common enough in deep intoxication. More remarkable was what Naomasa saw when he lowered his gaze, first to his left.

lines.jp: 「うっふっふ、若旦那、あなたちょっと可愛い顔してるじゃない」
lines.en: Hee-hee. Young master, you have quite a sweet little face.

lines.jp:
「へっへっへー。そう？　そう見えるん？
　今までそんなコト言われたコトないから、
　なんか嬉しいねえ」
lines.en:
Heh-heh-heh. Yeah? You really think so?
 Nobody's ever said that to me before,
 so that makes me kinda happy.

lines.jp:
緋色の薄衣の、深い襟刳りの中で膨らみは放埒これ極まるほどに張り詰めくっきり谷間を描いて、朔屋もここまでの、西瓜ほども有る乳房など輸入禁止のグラビア本くらいでしかお目にかかったことはない、西瓜、否、ウォーターメロンと言い換えよう。朔屋の同国人にも肌が白いのは多いが、それとは別質の、乳酪のような白さは異国の産、北方のコーカソイド特有の美質だからして。じろじろと賞翫する、目つきは三日月ににやついて、助平根性丸出しの、けれど女はむしろ誇らしげに胸を聳やかす気前の良さ、これも実に朔屋の意に適った。
　いつまででも視姦して飽きない乳房から、なんと朔屋が自ら視線を剥がしたのは、今さら遠慮からでない、遠慮するはずもない。
lines.en:
Beneath the deep neckline of a sheer scarlet dress, her swelling breasts strained with almost lawless abundance, forming a deep and unmistakable cleavage. Naomasa had only ever seen breasts the size of watermelons in imported pinup books that prudish authorities had forbidden. Watermelons--no, let us call them WATERMELONS. Plenty of his countrywomen had pale skin, but hers possessed a different, creamlike whiteness: the exotic beauty the age attributed to Caucasians of the northern lands. He openly feasted his eyes upon her, leering with a crescent grin and making no effort to conceal his lust. Rather than object, the woman generously thrust her chest out with pride. That, too, suited Naomasa perfectly.
 Astonishingly, he eventually tore his eyes from breasts he could have visually ravished forever. It was not out of belated restraint. He had none.

lines.jp: 「あら珍しい。大抵の男は、可愛いって言われるとむかっ腹立てるもんだけど」
lines.en: How unusual. Most men get angry when someone calls them cute.

lines.jp:
白い乳房の像を目の裏に残して視線を今度は右に廻らせると、残映消える前に別の乳房にと落ち着いた。こちらは濃緑のドレスだが、やはり胸元大胆に開けて、張り詰めているのが信じられないことに左と同じ規模の偉大なる双乳である。一人だけならまだともかく、これほどまでの乳房がいま一人、こういう幸運にぶち当たった男は、むしろ反動の不運の返し矢恐れるものだが、朔屋にそんな思慮などなくて、女神様二柱もご光臨とへらへらへら、好物はいくら食っても食中りしないと真面目に信じている他愛ない浮かれ者である。
　ただ───どでかいウォーターメロン級のおっぱいが二つあるのは素晴らしい、幾らあっても困らない、が。
lines.en:
Leaving the image of those white breasts behind his eyelids, he turned to the right. Before the afterimage could fade, his gaze settled upon another pair. This woman wore a deep green dress, likewise cut daringly low. Incredibly, the magnificent breasts straining within it were the same vast size as those on the left. One such woman would have been enough; a second helping of such impossible abundance ought to make any man fear an equal and opposite stroke of misfortune. Naomasa possessed no such foresight. Two goddesses had descended before him, and he could only grin. He sincerely believed one could never suffer from too much of a favorite food.
Still--two pairs of enormous watermelon breasts were wonderful. You could never have too many. And yet--

lines.jp: 左の女はおっぱいからして一大スペクタクルなのに、その上に乗っているのがすこぶる付きの、目鼻立ちくっきりと鮮やかな野生美溢るる美女とあっては既にサービス過剰の域に達しているが、まだ待てよかし、右の女も刮目して見ろ、こちらも折り紙付きの美貌の主で、もう椀盤振る舞いは青天井に突き抜けた。が。
lines.en: The woman on the left already offered a grand spectacle from the neck down. To crown it with the striking features of a vivid, wild beauty was generosity beyond reason. But wait: feast your eyes on the woman to the right. Hers, too, was beauty beyond dispute. Fortune's lavish banquet had burst through the ceiling and into the open sky. And yet--

lines.jp: なぜ、二人共に同じ貌なのだ？　右左で寸分違えず、灯りを二重写しに見るように、酔眼に人の輪郭がぶれるのはよくある酔い心地といっても限度がある。が。
lines.en: Why did both women have the same face? Right and left matched in every detail. Drunken eyes often made a person's outline double, just as they had doubled the light, but even intoxication had limits. And yet--

lines.jp: なべてこの世は事も為し、美人が二人に分裂したところでなんの不都合があると、朔屋は右に笑って左にも笑って、二人の見事に縊れた腰に腕を回して抱き寄せる、その際薬指で脇腹をくすぐるのも忘れない。この下品なお触りに、美女二人は揃って身をくねらせてからお返しに腕を抓ってきたが、それさえ酔った身には礼儀正しいご褒美でしかなかった。
lines.en: All was right with the world. What possible objection could there be if one beauty split into two? Naomasa smiled right and then left, wrapped an arm around each exquisitely narrow waist, and pulled them close. He did not forget to tickle their sides with his ring fingers in the process. Both beauties squirmed at his vulgar touch, then pinched his arms in retaliation, but to his drunken body even that felt like a polite reward.

lines.jp: 「いやあ俺は、褒めてくれるんならなんだって嬉しいって。たといおべっかだって、言われて悪い気はしないやな」
lines.en: Hey, any compliment makes me happy. Even if it's flattery, it still feels good to hear.

lines.jp: 「だっておべっか使ってくれるくらいには、脈が有るってコトだろう？　それなら誘ってみても、芽の一つだってあるかもだしさ」
lines.en: If you're willing to flatter me, that means I've got at least some chance with you, right? So maybe if I ask, there might be a little hope.

lines.jp: 「だから、な、君。どうかなこの後。河岸替えてゆっくりやるのは」
lines.en: So, hey, you. What do you say we go somewhere else after this and take our time?

lines.jp:
常日頃から脈有りそうな女と見ると、あわよくばのつまみ食いを狙う朔屋の、ましてこの時は強かに酒が入っている。
　媚薬というのはある意味で人類の見果てぬ夢であるが、そうマンドラゴラだのダチュラだの秘教的な薬種に血道を挙げずとも実に身近に転がっている。そう酒だ。酒に欲望存分に刺激された朔屋は、どうすればこの性的魅力の結実たる肢体と仲良く出来るか、それしか考えられなくなってある。
lines.en:
Naomasa habitually tried to sample any woman who appeared even remotely interested, and on this occasion he had a great deal of alcohol inside him.
 In one sense, an aphrodisiac was an unrealized dream of mankind, but there was no need to obsess over esoteric ingredients like mandrake or datura. One lay close at hand: alcohol. With drink stimulating his desires to their fullest, Naomasa could think of nothing but how he might become better acquainted with these bodies in which sexual allure had achieved its perfect fruit.

lines.jp:
出会ってから数刻も待たずの二人だが、男女の仲は段階的に、などと言ったお作法はこの男の脳からは欠落している。大体どういうきっかけで同じ席についたのか、そんな事さえはっきりと思い出せないのだ。
　あの雑踏の中の、奇妙に心騒がせらるる後ろ姿を途中までは追いかけていたらしい。後ろ姿に何処か旅のこしらえを見て、旅行者達が集まるような酒場をトンビに何軒か渡ったようだ。
lines.en:
Only a few hours had passed since he met them, but the notion that relations between men and women ought to proceed by stages was missing from his mind. He could not even clearly remember how they had come to share a table.
 He seemed to have followed that strangely stirring figure from the crowd for a while. Seeing something of a traveler's preparations in the silhouette, he apparently drifted like a kite from one tavern frequented by travelers to the next.

lines.jp:
ようだ、らしいとぼやけているのは、ここが何軒目なのか覚えていないからだし、美女二人もいつの間にか両隣にあって酌してくれていたからで。
　なんにせよ、朔屋にとって突きつめるべきは二人との経緯ではなく、この後いかにして仲良しさんになってお布団と枕も仲良く一緒にするかだった。
lines.en:
Why all the 'seemed' and 'apparently'? Because he could no longer remember how many taverns he had visited. The two beauties had simply appeared at either side and begun pouring his drinks.
 In any event, Naomasa had no interest in tracing how he had met them. His sole concern was how to become very good friends with both women afterward--and arrange for their bedding and pillows to become equally well acquainted.

lines.jp: 「やーだ、若旦那、どっちを誘ってンのォ？」
lines.en: Oh, come on, young master. Which one of us are you inviting?

lines.jp:
「どっちって……あれ、どっちがどっちだっけ？　しっかし君ら、えらく似てるなあ。
　白人の美人さんって、そんな風に似てくんのかい？」
lines.en:
Which one...? Wait, which of you is which? You two look an awful lot alike.
 Do pretty white girls just all look alike or something?

lines.jp:
「くふふ、なんかもう酔っ払ってるんじゃない？　顔で見分けがつかないなら、
　こっちなら……どう？」
lines.en:
Heh-heh. Aren't you simply drunk already? If you can't tell us apart by our faces,
 how about... this?

lines.jp:
女の、肩に回した手が滑って、胸元に張り詰めた弾力に落ちても、酔いの弾みで許される、そのまま手の腹で柔らかさを撫でてみたって、過失の延長として見逃してもらえる事もあろう。酒場の片隅に引っこんだ、朔屋と美女二人を包む暗がりは、三人の体熱に緩んで、そういう淫靡な戯れ合いを許すような温度を孕んだ。
　三人の身じろぎの度に、落ちかかる明かりの中に胸の谷間が白々と浮かぶ、ドレスの裾からは締まった脹ら脛が零れる。
lines.en:
A hand resting around a woman's shoulder might slip onto the taut resilience of her breast, forgiven as a drunken accident. If his palm then happened to stroke its softness, perhaps that, too, could pass as an extension of the same mistake. Darkness enclosed Naomasa and the two beauties in a corner of the tavern. Their body heat softened it into a warmth that seemed to permit such indecent play.

lines.jp: ただ、最後に美女が、かわるがわる朔屋の横顔に軽い口づけを置いていった事まで覚えていられないのは、少し気の毒───諸々合わせるとその程度の気休めでは到底勘定が合わないとしても、やはり気の毒、女と酒に思いきりつまずいた、自業自得だとしても。
lines.en: It was a little unfortunate that he could not even remember how, at the end, the beauties had each planted a light kiss on his cheek. Granted, that small consolation came nowhere near balancing the ledger after everything else, but it was unfortunate all the same--even if his spectacular fall over women and drink was entirely his own fault.
